description: Get Kubernetes system events for a Code Engine application (via the CE Kubernetes API proxy). Useful for diagnosing why an app fails to start — e.g. ImagePullBackOff, CrashLoopBackOff, insufficient quota, failed health checks. Events are retained by the platform for roughly 60 minutes.

namespace.description: Optional: project namespace (subdomain) override, if it cannot be auto-derived.

name: ce_get_app_events
